items.title: Speaker-labeled transcription with WhisperX on SageMaker AI
items.summary: The AWS WhisperX Deep Learning Container packages Whisper, wav2vec2 forced alignment, and speaker diarization into a GPU-ready image. Learn how to deploy it to Amazon SageMaker AI real-time and asynchronous endpoints for word-level, speaker-labeled transcription, plus the production details that matter: the GPU AMI pin, scaling, and cost controls.

items.title: Build a multi-account AI agent with AgentCore Gateway and MCP
items.summary: Build a multi-account architecture that keeps each team’s data in its own AWS account while giving AI agents a unified way to query across them. A central platform account runs the agent using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway and MCP, while line-of-business accounts expose their data as MCP servers with secure cross-account access and fine-grained authorization.

items.title: Aderant builds intelligent ticket triage with Amazon Nova
items.summary: Learn how Aderant built an intelligent ticket triage system on Amazon Nova Lite through Amazon Bedrock, automating context gathering, classification, routing, and knowledge enrichment for its cloud operations team.

items.title: From portal-hopping to instant answers: HEMA’s journey with MCP and Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: HEMA, a 100-year-old Dutch retailer, turned developer portal-hopping into instant answers by building HAL, an internal AI assistant on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Using Model Context Protocol (MCP), HAL delivers governed knowledge inside the tools teams already use, with no AWS credentials on the client and security anchored in Microsoft Entra ID.

items.title: Agentic conversational video intelligence built on AWS
items.summary: Learn how to build a conversational video intelligence solution on AWS using an agentic architecture. A single Strands Agents SDK agent orchestrates Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Rekognition, and Amazon Transcribe at runtime, deciding which service to call so you can ask natural language questions about your videos and get answers in seconds.

items.title: Use open weight models as your AI coding agent with Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Pair OpenCode, an open-source terminal-native AI coding agent, with open weight models on Amazon Bedrock to get a secure, flexible, pay-per-use coding assistant. Learn how to configure multi-model workflows, match the right model to each task, and keep your data in your own AWS account with no infrastructure to manage.

items.title: Bring more intelligence to everyday work with GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna are now generally available on Amazon Bedrock, giving you more options to match intelligence and efficiency to each workload.

items.title: Claude Opus 5.5 is now available on AWS
items.summary: Claude Opus 5.5, Anthropic’s most capable Opus model for agentic coding, knowledge work, and long-running tasks, is now available on Amazon Bedrock and Claude Platform on AWS. This post covers what’s new in Opus 5.5, practical guidance, and how to start building with the model on Amazon Bedrock.

items.title: Evaluate skill-equipped agents with Strands Evals and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Skills let you encode domain-specific procedures as reusable, portable instructions for agents, but a fluent answer doesn’t prove the agent picked the right skill or followed it. Learn how to measure skill selection and instruction following with Strands Evals and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations.

items.title: How Reactiv automates mobile commerce 80% faster with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Reactiv used Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to build a multi-agent AI Scheduler that autonomously refreshes Shopify merchants’ mobile apps on a schedule, reducing merchant configuration time by 80% and getting to production 33% faster.
